name: First Rehab
what_they_do: Outpatient physical, occupational and hand therapy clinic with a Spotswood office at 404 Main St and a second clinic in Lakewood. Site says it opened in 2007 and markets a large open gym, state-of-the-art equipment and one-on-one therapy.
customers: Injured and post-surgical adults, plus hand-injury and occupational-therapy patients; most are referred by physicians or insurance networks (inference from 'Diagnosis' and 'Referral source' fields on their scheduling form).

size_signals.signal: Two locations advertised on site (Lakewood and Spotswood); 'Since opening in 2007'
Staff page lists multiple named clinicians incl. OTs and DPTs
Careers page exists, implying ongoing hiring

website_review.primary_cta: BOOK NOW (goes to /schedule-an-appointment/) plus tel: click-to-call in the header
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Request form only (Contact Form 7, with reCAPTCHA); the 'Location' dropdown offers only Lakewood
website_review.trust_signals: Long testimonial wall with patient first names and towns, staff bios with credentials, clinic interior photos, 'since 2007'
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright is current (2026) and pages were last modified March 2026; but the locations page and footer only mention Lakewood - the Spotswood clinic is absent from the whole site (no Spotswood page in the XML sitemap).
website_review.search_basics: Title and description name the services and both towns ('Physical / Occupational Therapy Lakewood & Spotswood, NJ'); PT, OT, hand therapy and conditions each have their own pages; Organization JSON-LD present but describes the Lakewood clinic.
top_issues: Spotswood location has no page, address, hours or phone anywhere on the site, even though the Google profile links here
Header click-to-call shows the Lakewood number (732.884.2020), not the Spotswood number (732.251.6640)
Scheduling form's location dropdown lists only Lakewood, so a Spotswood patient cannot request that location online

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: claimed-looking Google profile with 5.0/10 reviews, hours and website link; robots.txt is allow-all. Answerable: proper service pages and Organization JSON-LD, but no Spotswood NAP or hours as text. Bookable: form exists but excludes the Spotswood location and sits behind reCAPTCHA with placeholder-only fields.

operations_signals.signal: Patient intake collects diagnosis and referral source on a web form - a manual triage step for front desk staff
Submitting the form produces no confirmation of a slot; staff must call back, which is a plus for review follow-up but a delay for patients
Hiring signals via a careers page (staff turnover or growth means more intake/admin load)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a real Spotswood location page (address, hours, local phone, therapist, directions) and wire it into the schedule form's location list, so Google traffic lands somewhere that matches the clinic
top_opportunities.evidence: Google profile for 404 Main St links to first-rehab.com, whose locations page and sitemap mention only Lakewood

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add location-specific LocalBusiness/MedicalClinic JSON-LD and per-location hours text so AI assistants can answer 'First Rehab Spotswood hours/phone'
top_opportunities.evidence: Only a generic Organization/WebPage @graph exists; no Spotswood NAP in the markup or on-page text

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated intake agent that captures referral/insurance details, checks the requested location and books or offers slots, replacing the callback loop
top_opportunities.evidence: Form asks for diagnosis and referral source then relies on staff follow-up; no calendar availability online

scores.reasons: Gap: two-clinic practice whose site ignores half its footprint. Pay: multi-clinician, two-site therapy business with insurance billing. Ease: a single well-built location page and a form dropdown fix is days of work. Evidence: verified on the live site, sitemap, form and Google profile.
